headers.//: THE KILL SWITCH MUST NOT BE CACHEABLE. A kill switch behind a CDN cache is a kill switch that takes an hour to arrive, which on the day it is needed is the same as not having one. See src/pwa/killSwitch.ts.

The worker script itself. A stale sw.js is a stale cache policy, and the browser only re-checks it on navigation. `no-cache` (revalidate every time) rather than `no-store`, so an unchanged worker still costs a 304 and not a full download.
The manifest changes with the build and is small. Revalidate rather than pin.

Content-hashed filenames are immutable by construction, so this is the one place a year-long max-age is honest. The service worker precaches them anyway; this is for the first visit and for anyone who never installs.
